details.description: Qwen2.5-72B-Instruct is a 72.7-billion-parameter (70.0B non-embedding) instruction-tuned chat model from Alibaba's Qwen team, released September 2024. Unlike most Qwen2.5 sizes it is released under the Qwen license rather than Apache 2.0. It has 80 transformer layers with grouped-query attention (64 query heads, 8 key-value heads). Compared with Qwen2, Qwen states the 2.5 generation brings significantly more knowledge and stronger coding, math, instruction-following, and structured-data/JSON output.
advantages: Scores 86.6 on HumanEval and 88.2 on MBPP for code generation, per Qwen's published Qwen2.5 evaluation results.
Scores 83.1 on MATH and 95.8 on GSM8K, per Qwen's evaluation results.
Scores 84.1 on IFEval strict-prompt, an instruction-following benchmark, per Qwen's evaluation results.
use_cases: Code generation and software engineering assistance
Structured data understanding and JSON output generation

sources.title: Qwen2.5-LLM: Extending the boundary of LLMs

notes: Qwen's model card states this model natively supports up to 131,072 tokens of context (extendable with YaRN beyond a 32,768-token base config) and up to 8,192 output tokens. Catalog's facts (32,768 in/out) instead match what Fireworks AI, the hosting provider, itself lists as this deployment's context length ('32.7k tokens', no separate output cap), so the catalog value is kept and the maker's larger extended-context figure is not restated above.
